LV2_EVENT_TERMS.doc: The terms of the LV2 Event specification (event.lv2, from lv2 1.18.10), each mapped under its own name with its status for us (docs/data-layout.md).

Event.ruling: LV2 deprecates the event extension (owl:deprecated on http://lv2plug.in/ns/ext/event); a consumer that reads it does so to refuse it.
